limitations: Counts come from public persistent-CG device return arrays and device-written graph results, independently of failed Nsight kernel-name attribution.
CG residual/tolerance counters refer to the recursive squared residual and squared threshold. They are not independent true residual measurements.
CG iteration costs differ between FEM and shaft PC. Iteration shares are work counts, not GPU time shares.
Only final per-attempt FEM tolerance level is recorded, so this audit cannot assign each inner iteration to a tolerance level.
Extra per-solve counter kernels and frame/attempt readbacks perturb scheduling; this is not an isolated speed comparison or deterministic trajectory proof.
conclusion: Prepared reuse removes repeated invariant internal force/predictor/RHS preparation, but it does not remove per-trial FEM solves or PC correction solves. Overall actual FEM Krylov work changes only 65,514→65,453 iterations (−0.09%), PC 15,988→15,821 (−1.04%).

Lowering retains 30 endpoint solves + 97 dual-update repetitions + 285 preconditioned corrections = 412 force-map/FEM trials. Baseline 30 + 110 + 294 = 434. Finite normal response is already exact; these ALM dual repetitions are driven by tangential consistency.

Lowering final inner tolerance escalates from 0.003 to 0.0003 in 9 baseline versus 10 prepared steps. No recorded FEM or PC cap hits, recursive-tolerance failures, nonfinite results or rejected physical attempts occur in either run.

Many FEM calls already stop at zero iterations: overall 194→180; lowering 111→98 and lift 73→73. Lowering zero-iteration counts nearly equal dual updates 110→97, consistent with unchanged-load dual repeats reusing a converged warm guess. Aggregate counters do not establish a one-to-one assignment, but show why skipping those solves alone need not remove substantial Krylov work.

The small wall improvement reported separately is consistent with removing one component of each trial while retaining nearly all Krylov iteration work and graph/force evaluation. These counters do not establish GPU time fractions or justify changing physical compliance/acceptance gates.
